diagnostics.message: The S3 notification must not be configured until the bucket's ownership controls and public-access block are applied; otherwise initial notification setup can be rejected or leave the bucket in an unintended configuration. Add an ordering dependency from the notification to these bucket controls.

The S3 bucket policy's ForceSSE deny policy relies on the bucket default encryption being established first; applying the policy before the encryption configuration risks rejecting requests made during setup. Order the policy after the encryption configuration.
The explicit dependency of aws_s3_object.trigger on aws_s3_bucket_notification.on_deploy is operationally significant, not redundant.
